import numpy as np, csv, itertools

# load data
data = np.genfromtxt('/app/bn_sample_10k.csv', delimiter=',', names=True)
cols = list(data.dtype.names)
X = np.column_stack([data[c] for c in cols]).T  # p x n
p, n = X.shape
print("cols:", cols, "n:", n)
Xc = X - X.mean(1, keepdims=True)
Sigma = (Xc @ Xc.T) / (n - 1)
prec = np.linalg.inv(Sigma)
D = np.diag(np.sqrt(np.diag(prec)))
Pcorr = -np.linalg.inv(D @ np.diag(np.diag(prec)) @ D)  # partial corr matrix
# actually: partial corr matrix = -D^{1/2}?? let's do properly:
# prec = D * Pcorr * D where D=diag(sqrt(prec[i,i]))
Pcorr = -prec / np.outer(np.sqrt(np.diag(prec)), np.sqrt(np.diag(prec)))
np.fill_diagonal(Pcorr, 1.0)
print("\nPartial correlations (t = r*sqrt(n-|Z|-1), |Z|=3, df=9996):")
pairs = list(itertools.combinations(range(p), 2))
for i, j in pairs:
    r = Pcorr[i, j]
    t = r * np.sqrt((n - 4) / (1 - r**2))
    print(f"{cols[i]}-{cols[j]}: r={r:+.4f}  t={t:+.1f}  {'EDGE' if abs(t)>5 else '  '}")
